en: Black-and-white multi-view postcard showing a large baroque courtyard complex. The top image appears to be an old painting or engraving of the site with carriages and people in 18th–19th‑century clothing. The two lower photographs show the same baroque pavilion wings and richly decorated gate surrounding a fountain basin, with visitors in 20th‑century dress. The architecture features long colonnaded façades with many tall windows, elaborate sculptural ornament, and the distinctive crowned portal of the complex.
